issues.detail: The Greek 'ουπως μου ερχομενος εμπροσθεν μου γεγονεν οτι πρωτος μου ην' describes the person coming *before* the speaker ('πρωτος μου ην' - was first than me), whereas the Vietnamese translation says 'Đấng đến sau ta đã trổi hơn ta' (The one who comes *after* me is greater than me). The Greek indicates precedence in time/order, while the Vietnamese adds a comparative of 'greatness' ('trổi hơn') not present in the text.
